description: In front of you on a green cloth are small piles of colorful plastic beads, a brown cord with a few beads already on it, and a black tape dispenser. The left hand holds the cord end steady near the purple-and-white bead pile while the right hand repeatedly reaches to the bead piles, pinches up a single bead, brings it down to the cord tip, threads it on, then briefly slides it along the cord before releasing and reaching for another bead.
